faqs.a: Yes. Plans range from 6 to 36 months, all at 0% interest. Terms and eligible cards apply.

faqs.q: Why are your costs higher than some other centres?
faqs.a: Advanced technology, experienced surgeons, unusually thorough pre-treatment examinations, nationwide aftercare and a lifetime warranty programme. We'd rather offer 0% instalments than compromise on any of these.

faqs.q: Why don't you offer lower-priced laser treatments?
faqs.a: We used to, but we've replaced older methods with newer ones that are more predictable and accurate. For example, ZEISS SMILE® is flapless and bladeless with better comfort after treatment, and bladeless Femto-LASIK is safer and more precise than the older blade LASIK.
